ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: Enable Mirostat sampling for controlling perplexity. (default: 0, 0 = disabled, 1 = Mirostat, 2 = Mirostat 2.0)
ast.target: 启用Mirostat采样以控制困惑度。(默认：0，0=禁用，1=Mirostat，2=Mirostat 2.0)

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: Influences how quickly the algorithm responds to feedback from the generated text. A lower learning rate will result in slower adjustments, while a higher learning rate will make the algorithm more responsive. (Default: 0.1)
ast.target: 影响算法对生成文本反馈的响应速度。较低的学习率会导致调整较慢，较高的学习率会使算法响应更快。(默认：0.1)

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: Controls the balance between coherence and diversity of the output. A lower value will result in more focused and coherent text. (Default: 5.0)
ast.target: 控制输出的连贯性与多样性之间的平衡。较低的值会产生更集中、更连贯的文本。(默认：5.0)

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: Sets the size of the context window used to generate the next token. (Default: 2048)
ast.target: 设置用于生成下一个token的上下文窗口大小。(默认：2048)

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: The number of GQA groups in the transformer layer. Required for some models, for example it is 8 for llama2:70b.
ast.target: Transformer层中GQA组的数量。某些模型需要此设置，例如llama2:70b为8。

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: Sets the number of threads to use during computation. By default, Ollama will detect this for optimal performance. It is recommended to set this value to the number of physical CPU cores your system has (as opposed to the logical number of cores).
ast.target: 设置计算时使用的线程数。默认情况下，Ollama会自动检测以实现最佳性能。建议将此值设置为系统物理CPU核心数（而非逻辑核心数）。

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: Sets how far back for the model to look back to prevent repetition. (Default: 64, 0 = disabled, -1 = num_ctx)
ast.target: 设置模型回溯以防止重复的距离。(默认：64，0=禁用，-1=num_ctx)

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: Sets how strongly to penalize repetitions. A higher value (e.g., 1.5) will penalize repetitions more strongly, while a lower value (e.g., 0.9) will be more lenient. (Default: 1.1)
ast.target: 设置惩罚重复的强度。较高的值（如1.5）会更强地惩罚重复，较低的值（如0.9）会更宽松。(默认：1.1)

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: Sets the random number seed to use for generation. Setting this to a specific number will make the model generate the same text for the same prompt.
ast.target: 设置用于生成的随机数种子。将其设置为特定数字将使模型对同一提示生成相同的文本。

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: Sets the stop sequences to use. When this pattern is encountered, the LLM will stop generating text and return. Multiple stop patterns may be set by specifying them as a comma-separated list in the input field.
ast.target: 设置要使用的停止序列。当遇到此模式时，LLM将停止生成文本并返回。可以通过在输入字段中指定逗号分隔列表来设置多个停止模式。

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: Tail free sampling is used to reduce the impact of less probable tokens from the output. A higher value (e.g., 2.0) will reduce the impact more, while a value of 1.0 disables this setting. (default: 1)
ast.target: 尾部自由采样用于减少输出中概率较低标记的影响。较高的值（例如2.0）会更多地减少影响，而值为1.0则禁用此设置。（默认值：1）

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: Reduces the probability of generating nonsense. A higher value (e.g. 100) will give more diverse answers, while a lower value (e.g. 10) will be more conservative. (Default: 40)
ast.target: 降低生成无意义内容的概率。较高的值（例如100）会得到更多样化的回答，而较低的值（例如10）则更加保守。（默认值：40）

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: Works together with top-k. A higher value (e.g., 0.95) will lead to more diverse text, while a lower value (e.g., 0.5) will generate more focused and conservative text. (Default: 0.9)
ast.target: 与top-k一起使用。较高的值（例如0.95）会导致更多样化的文本，而较低的值（例如0.5）会产生更集中和保守的文本。（默认值：0.9）

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: Alternative to the top_p, and aims to ensure a balance of quality and variety. The parameter p represents the minimum probability for a token to be considered, relative to the probability of the most likely token. (Default: 0.0)
ast.target: top_p的替代方案，旨在确保质量和多样性之间的平衡。参数p表示相对于最可能标记概率的、要考虑的标记的最小概率。（默认值：0.0）

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: If set to a positive duration (e.g. 20m, 1hr or 30), the model will stay loaded for the provided duration in seconds. If set to a negative duration (e.g. -1), the model will stay loaded indefinitely. If set to 0, the model will be unloaded immediately once finished. If not set, the model will stay loaded for 5 minutes by default.
ast.target: 如果设置为正持续时间（例如20m、1hr或30），模型将在提供的持续时间（秒）内保持加载。如果设置为负持续时间（例如-1），模型将无限期保持加载。如果设置为0，模型将在完成后立即卸载。如果未设置，模型默认将保持加载5分钟。
